sources: Gantz, Jeffrey, trans. *The Mabinogion*. New York: Barnes & Noble Books, 1976, pp. 72, 75, 87.
Monaghan, Patricia. The Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore. Checkmark Books, 2008.
text: Cymidei Cymeinfoll, a giantess of Welsh legend, is counted as a heroine. She is the wife of a giant named Llassar Llaesgyfnewid. The pair owns a magic cauldron of regeneration. That vessel gives rise to much of the action in the second branch of the Mabinogion. Cymidei gives birth to many armed warriors. She bears those fighters once every six weeks. Her name, translated, points to a warrior of the belly.
